findings.kind: dimension does not match drawn geometry
findings.element: Top dimension chain, 2nd segment (inner face of left exterior wall to left face of the 11.5 cm partition) = WOHNEN width
findings.explanation: The dimension line runs from x=121.89 pt to x=286.30 pt, i.e. 164.41 pt. At 1:100 (1 pt = 0.03528 m) that is 5.800 m, not 5.86 m. The scale is confirmed by the shell: 283.46 pt = 10.00 m and 198.42 pt = 7.00 m exactly.

findings.kind: dimension does not match drawn geometry
findings.element: Top dimension chain, 4th segment (right face of the 11.5 cm partition to inner face of right exterior wall) = SCHLAFEN/BAD width
findings.explanation: The dimension line runs from x=289.56 pt to x=388.35 pt, i.e. 98.79 pt = 3.485 m at 1:100. The label reads 4.00, which is 51.5 cm too large. Even measured to the outer face of the right wall it would only be 3.79 m.

findings.kind: dimension chain does not add up to the overall dimension
findings.element: Top dimension chain (30 / 5.86 / 11.5 / 4.00 / 30) versus the overall 10.00 dimension above it
findings.explanation: The printed sub-dimensions sum to 0.30 + 5.86 + 0.115 + 4.00 + 0.30 = 10.575 m, but the overall dimension and the drawn shell are 10.00 m. The drawn geometry does add up correctly (0.30 + 5.80 + 0.115 + 3.485 + 0.30 = 10.00), so the two wrong labels (5.86 and 4.00) are the cause.
Clear internal size of WOHNEN is 164.41 pt x 181.42 pt = 5.800 m x 6.400 m = 37.12 m2. The label states 31.2 m2, which is 5.9 m2 too small.
Clear internal size of SCHLAFEN is 98.79 pt x 115.80 pt = 3.485 m x 4.085 m = 14.24 m2. The label states 13.4 m2, 0.84 m2 too small.

Clear internal size of BAD is 98.79 pt x 62.36 pt = 3.485 m x 2.200 m = 7.67 m2. The label states 6.9 m2, 0.77 m2 too small. Cross-check: the three labelled areas sum to 51.5 m2, whereas the internal floor area less the two partitions is 60.16 - 0.74 - 0.40 = 59.02 m2, matching the three measured areas (37.12 + 14.24 + 7.67 = 59.03 m2).

findings.element: BAD - only door is the 0.90 m opening in the SCHLAFEN/BAD partition
findings.explanation: The vertical 11.5 cm partition runs unbroken from the top wall to the bottom wall except for the single 1.00 m opening into SCHLAFEN, and the only other opening on the right-hand side is the 0.90 m door in the horizontal partition between SCHLAFEN and BAD. The bathroom is therefore reachable only by walking through the bedroom, and it has no direct connection to WOHNEN or to the entrance. Worth resolving before the plan goes out.

summary: The overall dimensions (10.00 x 7.00), the 30 cm exterior walls, the 11.5 cm partition, the 1:100 scale and all three door openings (1.00 / 1.00 / 0.90 m) check out against the vector geometry, but six labels do not. Two chain dimensions are wrong (5.86 should be 5.80, 4.00 should be 3.49), which is why the chain sums to 10.575 instead of the 10.00 printed above it, and all three room areas are understated (WOHNEN 31.2 vs 37.12 m2, SCHLAFEN 13.4 vs 14.24 m2, BAD 6.9 vs 7.67 m2). Separately, please check the layout: BAD has only one door and it opens into SCHLAFEN, so the bathroom can only be reached through the bedroom.
